description: Run an AX Audit on a URL — scores how ready a website is for AI agents across every real AR-* check this engine runs (robots.txt AI policy, llms.txt, agent.json, JSON-LD, OpenAPI, MCP/OAuth discovery, AR-PROV provisioning, and more — the exact check count grows over time, so it is intentionally not pinned here). Returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade, and a per-check breakdown. No authentication required.
name: scan_site
title: Scan site for AI-agent readiness
